question: Should OpenClaw accept the modular dashboard agent-status widget direction through the linked dashboard PR stack, or keep this issue as a narrower session/activity API and Control UI design task?
rationale: The current source has session-state primitives but not the requested dashboard widget surface, and the open PR introduces product/API direction beyond a small bug fix.

options.title: Review linked dashboard PR
options.body: Treat the open dashboard widget PR as the implementation candidate and decide whether its plugin/widget architecture is the desired product path.

options.title: Narrow to status API work
options.body: Keep this issue focused on session/activity data contracts and defer the modular dashboard surface to the roadmap hub.

recommendation.title: Review linked dashboard PR
recommendation.body: Treat the open dashboard widget PR as the implementation candidate and decide whether its plugin/widget architecture is the desired product path.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main history and merge authority make this the best available owner for product/API direction on this dashboard/session-state decision.
